name: Power-transformer primary bay arrangement
summary: Connects the transformer high-voltage winding through its assigned bay switching and measurement devices.
description: Connects the transformer high-voltage winding through its assigned bay switching and measurement devices. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Bus and primary bay” at the input and “Transformer primary connection” at the output. Other transformer windings can provide alternative sources.

Preserve the actual order of primary connections, isolation points and CT locations. These conceptual arrangements do not establish equipment clearances, terminal layouts or an approved switching sequence. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
